PT Japfa Food Indonesia (Wonoayu)

Job Responsibilities:**
* Supervise and coordinate the activities of production personnel, including training, performance management, and scheduling.
* Monitor production processes to ensure compliance with established quality standards, specifications, and safety regulations.
* Develop and implement production schedules, ensuring timely completion of orders and efficient resource utilization.
* Identify and resolve production issues, equipment malfunctions, and process deviations to minimize downtime and maximize output.
* Implement and enforce company policies and procedures, including those related to safety, hygiene, and environmental protection.
* Maintain accurate production records, including daily output, waste, and quality control data.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as quality control, maintenance, and logistics, to optimize overall operational efficiency.
* Conduct regular inspections of production facilities and equipment to ensure proper functioning and adherence to maintenance schedules.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities for process optimization and cost reduction.
* Ensure a safe working environment for all production staff, promoting safety awareness and adherence to safety protocols.

Job Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (e.g., Food, Industrial, Chemical, Mechanical) or a related field.
* Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a production supervisory role within the manufacturing industry, preferably in animal feed or food processing.
* Strong leadership and team management skills with the ability to motivate and develop staff.
* Excellent understanding of production processes, quality control principles, and safety regulations.
* Proficient in using production management software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to identifying and addressing operational challenges.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with various departments.
* Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and ISO standards is highly desirable.
* Willingness to work in shifts and adapt to flexible working hours as required by production demands.
